propositions: Eight unguarded pytest CI lanes lack per-test hang guards (--timeout and --timeout-method=thread), allowing deadlocked tests to hide behind final output dots with no traceback
Per-test timeout budgets must be calibrated per-lane from historical runtime data rather than using a single blanket value, with minimum 300s and at least 10x observed mean per-test duration

Detection rule requires exhaustive sweep over all .github/workflows files with regex matching pytest commands at command boundaries and asserting both --timeout= and --timeout-method=thread flags are present
Four distinct pytest invocation forms must be covered: bare pytest, pytest -m, python -m pytest, and path-prefixed python, while rejecting shell comments and non-command-boundary occurrences
Each per-lane timeout budget and its historical evidence must be recorded as YAML comments at the step it governs for auditability
